aliases: 皇帝巡幸左神策军纪圣德碑
backgroundZh: 碑为记天子巡幸左神策军而立。原石在禁中，传拓不易，后来石佚。今日所见，是宋装拓本幸存的一卷。
background: A stele erected inside the palace compound to commemorate an imperial visit to the left Shence Army. Because the site was closed, few rubbings were ever taken; the stone is lost and one volume of a Song mounting survives.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from a newspaper article by a library staff member. The 843 date refers to the lost stone, not to the surviving rubbing.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据图书馆员撰写的报纸文章整理的草稿；843 年为已佚原石之刻立年，不是存世拓本年代。

notes: The article does not describe the missing lower volume beyond noting that it is lost.
notesZh: 文章除称下册已佚外，未描述其内容。
